title: Treaty of Hadiach
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Treaty of Hadiach", at revision 1378868976, opens: "The Treaty of Hadiach was a treaty signed on 16 September 1658 in Hadiach, Cossack Hetmanate between representatives of the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth and Ukrainian Cossacks." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q386038, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1658 treaty between Poland–Lithuania and Cossacks". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
